verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe a built-in chat interface for local models. Release notes back this with concrete GUI chat features: nested chat folders, paging between regenerated responses, themes and document attachment in chat. Community users independently confirm it ships 'a UI to chat with models easily' and call the UI 'powerful', though one reports rough edges such as no clear empty state in the chatbox. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the chat UI beyond brief feature blurbs, and polish on the community-reported UX issues.
